inputs.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 146.48 km (catalog ±1.74 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery. The physical size is approximately calibrated by assigning the AKARI thermal effective diameter to the mesh volume-equivalent diameter. Neither source mesh nor spin is modified. Convex inversion supplies only broad outline; no resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture can be inferred. Select the 2022 archive release of Hanuš et al. (2021) ASAS-SN model 6009. The paper table gives (108,-62), 47.015 h, and 348 photometric measurements. This is a complete convex model; ATLAS 2020 also reports a partial model with unconstrained longitude, which does not supersede it. AKARI scaling remains approximate.
